title: [FLINK-41017][table] Use `DecimalData#isCompact` while casting
body:
## What is the purpose of the change

The PR makes using `DecimalData#isCompact` while casting
which speeds up casting for DECIMAL (compact)

before 
```
Benchmark                                     (mode)   Mode  Cnt       Score      Error   Units
DecimalCastBenchmark.castToDecimal           compact  thrpt    5  140745.718 ± 2563.014  ops/ms
DecimalCastBenchmark.castToDecimal        nonCompact  thrpt    5   30191.612 ± 1002.180  ops/ms
```
after
```
Benchmark                                     (mode)   Mode  Cnt       Score      Error   Units
DecimalCastBenchmark.castToDecimal           compact  thrpt    5  385602.719 ± 6072.158  ops/ms
DecimalCastBenchmark.castToDecimal        nonCompact  thrpt    5   30335.500 ±  577.597  ops/ms
```
## Brief change log

DecimalData

existing tests + extra tests added
